beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: This balance sits level. Each block weighs the same.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five plus two on the left.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two plus five on the right.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven on each side. Equals means the same amount on both sides.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A number sentence with an equal sign is an equation. This one is true: both sides have the same amount.

do.meaning: A number sentence with an equal sign.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven equals eight minus one. Is it true or false?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start with eight on the right. Take one away.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven on the left, seven on the right. True! A single number can be on either side of the equal sign.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two plus six equals seven minus one. Is it true or false?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Two plus six is eight, so it is true.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: That checks the left side. What is seven minus one?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Six! Eight and six are different, so it is false. I need to check both sides.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four plus nine equals box plus six. What goes in the box?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four plus nine makes thirteen.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The whole right side must make thirteen too.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six blocks are already there. Thirteen minus six leaves seven to add.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seven plus six is thirteen. Both sides match, so the box holds seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twenty-seven plus thirteen equals twenty-six plus fourteen. Is it true or false?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Each full tower has ten blocks.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: I move one block from the twenty-seven pile to the thirteen pile.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Twenty-seven becomes twenty-six. Thirteen becomes fourteen. No blocks came in or went away.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The total stays forty. So the equation is true!

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Equals means the same amount on both sides.
